Performance change within the context of the ADHD 2024 reporting highlights significant variations in regional outcomes over time, specifically tracked through [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]. Monitoring these shifts is crucial for understanding how different Danish regions are improving their measured metrics year over year.

The most substantial driver of the overall performance change is [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]]. The region achieved a result of 51%, which represents a remarkable increase of 32 percentage points compared to the previous year [^src1]. This surge in Midtjylland's performance is the primary factor behind the broader positive trends observed in the dataset [^src1].

In addition to Midtjylland, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] has also demonstrated notable performance change. The region successfully improved its metric from 16% in the 2023/24 period to 26% in the 2024/25 period [^src1]. Together, these regional improvements illustrate a significant upward trajectory in the measured outcomes across the regions.
